title.zh: 实验演示 · HPWL 实验台

lines.zh: 这是实验台。打开时载入老师的起始布局，总 HPWL 是 52。
lines.en: This is the lab. It opens with the teacher's starter layout: total HPWL 52.
lines.speak_zh: 这是实验台。打开时载入老师的起始布局，总 H P W L 是 52。
lines.speak_en: This is the lab. It opens with the teacher's starter layout, with a total H P W L of fifty-two.

lines.zh: 点一个线网，它的包围盒和极值引脚就会高亮，表格也同时更新。
lines.en: Click a net to highlight its box and extreme pins; the table updates at the same time.

lines.zh: 直接拖动单元。把 C 拖到 (3, 5)，相关线网当场重算。
lines.en: Drag a cell directly. Move C to (3, 5) and every net it touches is recomputed.
lines.speak_zh: 直接拖动单元。把 C 拖到 3、5，相关线网当场重算。
lines.speak_en: Drag a cell directly. Move C to three, five, and every net it touches is recomputed.

lines.zh: 也可以用键盘：选中单元后按方向键；撤销按钮随时退回上一步。
lines.en: Or use the keyboard: focus a cell and press the arrow keys. Undo steps back at any time.

lines.zh: 逐步扫描一次读一个引脚，演示最小值和最大值怎样更新。
lines.en: The step-by-step scan reads one pin at a time and shows how the min and max update.

lines.zh: 切换到固定焊盘模式：A 和 D 被锁住，拖不动，状态栏会说明原因。
lines.en: Switch to fixed-anchor mode: A and D are locked, and the status line says why they will not move.

lines.zh: 看片时随时按“试试这一帧”，实验台会接过画面上的真实坐标。
lines.en: While watching, press “Try this frame” and the lab takes over the exact coordinates on screen.
lines.speak_zh: 看片时，随时按“试试这一帧”，实验台会接过画面上的真实坐标。
lines.speak_en: While watching, press Try this frame, and the lab takes over the exact coordinates on screen.

lines.zh: 挑战检查的是你在实验台里的真实布局，不同的正确摆法都能通过。
lines.en: Challenges check the real layout in your lab, so different correct arrangements all pass.

lines.zh: 最后下载 Python 练习包，补全函数，用检查脚本验证你的实现。
lines.en: Finally, download the Python pack, complete the functions, and verify them with the checker.
